BackstoryDef.title: boarding academy scholar
BackstoryDef.description: Educated inside a centuries-old occult boarding school, [PAWN_nameDef] learned that emotion is a liability and ancient sigils are instruments of control. [PAWN_pronoun] excelled at dissecting forbidden texts with icy detachment.

BackstoryDef.title: high elder of london
BackstoryDef.description: A senior council member of the British Men of Letters, [PAWN_nameDef] views foreign hunters as reckless amateurs who must either submit to British oversight or be eliminated. Ruthless, aristocratic, and utterly uncompromising, [PAWN_pronoun] enforces absolute secrecy.

BackstoryDef.title: kendricks academy prodigy
BackstoryDef.description: Stripped of sentiment in the brutal halls of the order's private academy, [PAWN_nameDef] was conditioned to become the ultimate clean-up specialist. [PAWN_pronoun] mastered firearms, blades, and arcane ward-breakers before leaving adolescence.

BackstoryDef.title: black-ops occult assassin
BackstoryDef.description: Dressed in a bespoke suit with a briefcase full of enchanted weapons, [PAWN_nameDef] eliminates monsters and rogue humans with polite, sociopathic precision. Though [PAWN_pronoun] occasionally develops twisted respect for worthy adversaries, [PAWN_pronoun] rarely leaves witnesses behind.

BackstoryDef.title: london street recruit
BackstoryDef.description: Picked off the gritty streets of London by recruiters of the secret order, [PAWN_nameDef] was forced to endure harsh tests of loyalty to earn a place among aristocratic scholars. [PAWN_pronoun] survived by keeping [PAWN_possessive] wits sharp and reading people's intentions.

BackstoryDef.title: field liaison operative
BackstoryDef.description: Dispatched overseas to recruit local hunters into the British Men of Letters, [PAWN_nameDef] relies on diplomacy, resources, and modern occult gadgets rather than brute force. Beneath [PAWN_possessive] polished manners lies a genuine conscience that clashes with London's ruthless code.

BackstoryDef.title: arcane academy prefect
BackstoryDef.description: Raised in the strict discipline of an ancient British coven-turned-academy, [PAWN_nameDef] memorized Enochian wards and psychological interrogation methods from childhood. [PAWN_pronoun] believed unyielding control was the only barrier against supernatural chaos.

BackstoryDef.title: occult inquisitor
BackstoryDef.description: An elite field agent and master of arcane mind-breaking, [PAWN_nameDef] extracts secrets through ritual torture and chemical elixirs. Cold, proud, and fanatically devoted to the order's mission, [PAWN_pronoun] treats resistance as a flaw to be corrected.

BackstoryDef.title: order garrison trainee
BackstoryDef.description: Trained behind the high walls of a remote British estate, [PAWN_nameDef] drilled endlessly in close-quarters combat, marksmanship, and monster containment. [PAWN_pronoun] learned early that hesitation in the dark meant certain death.

BackstoryDef.title: tactical strike commander
BackstoryDef.description: Leading the heavy tactical squads of the British Men of Letters, [PAWN_nameDef] executes containment sweeps with military precision and enchanted weaponry. Stoic, disciplined, and merciless toward supernatural threats, [PAWN_pronoun] cleanses entire strongholds without a word wasted.
